excerpt.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击将雪拉企业的财产和雇员置于危险当中，我们别无选择，只能终止我们之间的贸易协定，而且我们不会退款。
excerpt.en: Your reckless attacks have put XuraCorp property and employees at risk. We have no choice but to terminate our current trade agreement. There will be no refunds.

texts.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击将雪拉企业的财产和雇员置于危险当中，我们别无选择，只能终止我们之间的贸易协定，而且我们不会退款。
texts.en: Your reckless attacks have put XuraCorp property and employees at risk. We have no choice but to terminate our current trade agreement. There will be no refunds.

texts.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击威胁到了雪拉企业的财产和雇员的安全。最好记住，良好的客户关系是双向的。
texts.en: Your reckless attack endangers XuraCorp property and employees alike. You would do well to remember that good customer relations go both ways.

texts.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你已经涉足了自己无法理解的力量。谨言慎行，学会安于当下，因为在你选择的道路上，未来只会带来痛苦。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
texts.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"You have meddled with powers you cannot possibly comprehend. Tread carefully, and take what solace you can from the present, for on the path you've chosen the future holds only pain."

Due to [root.GetHisHer] involvement on the Council, the departure of [root.GetName] and [root.GetHisHer] staffers has caused major disruptions to government operations.

texts.zh: 你们竟然对我们的太空站发动袭击，不可原谅！我们不会再给你们运送货物了，明白吗？不会再给你们运送辛香料了！我们之间的贸易协定就此作废。
texts.en: Your attacks against our station are intolerable! You are cut off, do you understand? You may consider our trade agreement null and void.

texts.zh: 这次攻击无缘无故，毫无理由！我们绝不会容忍这样的行径！请你自行挂断吧。
texts.en: This attack is unprovoked and uncalled for! We will not stand for it. Consider yourselves cut off.

texts.zh: 啊，海盗终于展现出本来面目了！你们别想再从我们这里得到水晶了！任何一个穆塔根人都不会再和[Root.GetName]做交易了。
texts.en: Ah, so the pirates shows their true colors! You can forget about our trade deals! No Muutagan will do business with the [Root.GetName] again.

texts.zh: 你竟敢攻击我们？搞清楚点，你这海盗：我们最瞧不起的就是这样的野蛮行径。
texts.en: You dare to attack us?! Know this, pirates: we do not stand for such barbarism.
